$comment: Routing eval cases for scripts/run-evals.js. Each case is a realistic user prompt plus the skill that should win the TF-IDF ranking against every skill description in this repo. The two skills split on scope: authoring/planning ('script', 'draft', 'outline', 'transcript', 'timeline', 'plan') routes to screencast-storyboard; production/output ('record', 'produce', 'render', 'MP4', 'voice-over', 'captions') routes to screencast-tutorial-video. CI enforces --min-rank1 75.

prompts.prompt: help me script a tutorial showing how to add an MCP server in Claude Desktop
draft the transcript and timeline for a demo of setting up Claude Code
outline a screencast walkthrough covering this MCP install before we record anything
plan the storyboard for a walkthrough of using an MCP server in Claude Desktop
record the screencast from my approved storyboard
produce the narrated MP4 for this tutorial with a caption bar
render the tutorial video with voice-over and captions from the storyboard
cut the screencast scenes together into the final video file
